description: Source code for EntitiesVersionControlService, an Angular service managing entity version control operations including listing branches, saving versions, loading versions, comparing data, and handling errors within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: EntitiesVersionControlService
classes.description: Angular service providing entity version control functionalities such as listing branches, saving, loading, comparing versions, and error message translation.

methods.name: clearBranchList
methods.description: Resets the cached list of branches.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Retrieves the list of version control branches, with caching.

methods.name: getEntityDataInfo
methods.description: Fetches data info for a specific entity version.

methods.name: saveEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Saves a new entity version and polls for its creation status.

methods.name: listEntityVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of a specific entity within a branch.

methods.name: listEntityTypeVersions
methods.description: Lists versions for a specific entity type within a branch.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions within a branch.

methods.name: loadEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Loads a specific entity version and polls for completion.

methods.name: compareEntityDataToVersion
methods.description: Compares current entity data to a specific version.

methods.name: entityLoadErrorToMessage
methods.description: Converts an entity load error into a sanitized HTML message.
